course.name: Release and Rollback
course.description: Pin a tested flow version, promote a change and restore the prior target.
course.longDescription: 20 minutes required. Prerequisite: Events. Use a log-only practice flow so promotion and rollback have observable results without external effects. This course owns flow snapshots and Event version pins; package distribution and infrastructure deployment remain separate workflows.

modules.title: Build and check
modules.description: Complete the practical steps and inspect the result.

challenges.prompt: A pinned Event still prints release A after the draft is saved as release B. What does that show?
challenges.explanation: The Event is still invoking its selected immutable snapshot.

options.label: The Event is still invoking its selected immutable snapshot.
The Event automatically adopted release B but changed the log.

lessons.title: Test the candidate through an Event

challenges.prompt: The candidate works in Studio but the Event targets an entry node removed in that version. What remains before promotion?
challenges.explanation: Repair the Event/entry contract and test through the candidate Event.

options.label: Assume Studio success covers Event configuration.
Change the version label without testing.
Repair the Event/entry contract and test through the candidate Event.

challenges.prompt: Repointing an Event restores old logic after a bad version sent a message. What remains true?
challenges.explanation: The already sent message is an effect that rollback does not undo.

options.label: The old snapshot now contains the draft fix.
The already sent message is an effect that rollback does not undo.
Repointing deletes every effect from the bad version.

modules.title: Apply it
modules.description: Use the result to solve a new case.

challenges.prompt: A release renames a required API field. Which preparation fits?
challenges.explanation: Plan caller migration or compatibility and test the changed contract before promotion.

options.label: Plan caller migration or compatibility and test the changed contract before promotion.
Call it Patch solely because one line changed.
Rely on the new display label to update every caller.

challenges.prompt: The prior flow expects a database column that the release removed. Is repointing alone a proven rollback?
challenges.explanation: No. Check or restore dependency compatibility before relying on the prior flow.

options.label: Yes. Snapshots include every external database state.
Yes, if the old flow has a smaller version number.
No. Check or restore dependency compatibility before relying on the prior flow.

challenges.prompt: The draft is fixed but callers still use a pinned bad version. What changes their behavior?
challenges.explanation: Create and test a new snapshot, then deliberately repoint the Event.

options.label: Create and test a new snapshot, then deliberately repoint the Event.
Save the draft and assume every pin follows it.
